# CCMAF Skills — AI & Machine Learning (`ccmaf-skills-ai`)

Software built on models: LLM applications and agents on the Claude API, retrieval-augmented generation as an engineered component, and classic/deep machine learning you train yourself.

**Audience:** Engineers building on LLMs or training their own models.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-ai@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.
